item.title: eWiz 0.18.7
item.description:
The AI-agent server really no longer crashes when a session ends

The 0.18.5 fix only held on newer build tools, so the released ewiz-mcp still crashed every time Claude Code or another agent closed a session, which showed a "quit unexpectedly" report and skipped handing back any hold it had taken. It now exits cleanly whatever it's built with.
